clips.speaker: You Song
clips.title: 瑞银胡一帆：5月经济数据好坏参半，二季度GDP不会太弱

subtitles.en: Yeah, it's mixed.
subtitles.zh: 是的，好坏参半。

subtitles.en: But one thing I want to say is the IP data was okay.
subtitles.zh: 但我想说一点，工业增加值数据还可以。

subtitles.en: It wasn't particularly strong, but not quite as weak as it was in April.
subtitles.zh: 不算特别强劲，但也不像4月那么弱。

subtitles.en: One other important data, which is not, I think the market should pay more attention to is service output index.
subtitles.zh: 另一个重要数据，我认为市场应更多关注的是服务业产出指数。

subtitles.en: And that number was okay as well. Slightly higher than it was in April.
subtitles.zh: 这个数据也还可以，比4月略高。

subtitles.en: And there's two IP and service output. There's two indices have a fairly close correlation with GDP data.
subtitles.zh: 工业增加值和产出指数这两个指标与GDP数据相关性相当高。

subtitles.en: So I think two Q GDP data, by the way, looks, it's going to be weak, but not quite as weak as one would expect from April data.
subtitles.zh: 所以我认为二季度GDP数据看起来会偏弱，但不会像4月数据预示的那么弱。

clips.speaker_context: Chief China Economist at UBS Securities

clips.speaker: You Song
clips.title: 瑞银胡一帆：为何服务业产出指数比零售数据更能反映消费？
title_lines: 服务业产出指数 vs 零售数据

subtitles.en: Right, can I ask you then why place less weight on retail sales at this one in time?
subtitles.zh: 那么请问，为什么此时对零售数据的权重降低？

subtitles.en: Not necessarily less weight, but relatively to service output index. The important, I think it's lower, just because the two tend to have much lower level of correlation.
subtitles.zh: 不一定是权重降低，而是相对于服务业产出指数，零售数据的重要性较低，因为两者相关性较低。

subtitles.en: One reason is it's not a good, necessarily a good proxy for overall consumption. Which is often assumed to be the case.
subtitles.zh: 一个原因是零售数据未必是整体消费的良好代理指标，尽管人们常这么认为。

subtitles.en: Don't want to dismiss it, which is, it's meaningful. I think one way we try to gauge the likely outcome in terms of two Q GDP, the service output index is way more important.
subtitles.zh: 我不想忽视它，它有意义。但衡量二季度GDP可能结果时，服务业产出指数重要得多。

subtitles.en: Right, so how would you, on aggregate, how would you describe consumption at this point then?
subtitles.zh: 那么总体而言，你如何描述当前的消费状况？

subtitles.en: Conception is clearly not strong. So from one Q, there definitely was a meaningful slowdown.
subtitles.zh: 消费显然不强。从一季度开始，确实出现了明显的放缓。

clips.speaker_context: Chief China Economist at UBS Securities

clips.speaker: You Song
clips.title: 瑞银胡一帆：固定资产投资放缓是二季度经济主要拖累

subtitles.en: But I think the biggest doubt had probably happened in the fixed asset investments based instead of consumption.
subtitles.zh: 但我认为最大的问题可能出在固定资产投资，而非消费。

subtitles.en: So both were actually, both actually showed decent growth in one Q of the year and both likely slowed down going to the second quarter.
subtitles.zh: 两者在一季度都表现不错，但进入二季度都可能放缓。

subtitles.en: But in terms of the contribution to the slowdown, fixed asset investment growth has made a bigger contribution.
subtitles.zh: 但对放缓的贡献而言，固定资产投资增长贡献更大。

subtitles.en: And the key is the fixed asset investment growth in energy GDP accounting is not the same thing as the monthly data that we just saw.
subtitles.zh: 关键是，GDP核算中的固定资产投资增长与我们刚看到的月度数据不是一回事。

subtitles.en: We're talking about more than 40% of GDP. You saw 4% drop in fixed asset investments, right?
subtitles.zh: 它占GDP的40%以上。你看到固定资产投资下降了4%，对吧？

subtitles.en: It seems to be continuing to see downside when it comes to whether it's the property sector that's dragging these numbers.
subtitles.zh: 似乎持续下行，无论是房地产板块拖累这些数据。

subtitles.en: We had a real story earlier a few months ago about how even fiscally the government is spending less.
subtitles.zh: 几个月前有报道称，政府财政支出也在减少。

clips.speaker_context: Chief China Economist at UBS Securities

clips.speaker: You Song
clips.title: 瑞银胡一帆：政策调整过度导致投资放缓，二季度或超调
title_lines: 二季度投资放缓或超调

subtitles.en: What do you think is attributing to this slowdown in investment now in the economy?
subtitles.zh: 你认为是什么导致了当前经济中投资的放缓？

subtitles.en: I think it's a policy driven. A policy was pretty proactive in the beginning of the year, so it's government-led investments or private investments.
subtitles.zh: 我认为是政策驱动的。年初政策相当积极，无论是政府主导还是私人投资。

subtitles.en: So the momentum was reasonably strong, partially because this is the start of the new five-year plan period and the tendency to be relatively proactive at the beginning of the year.
subtitles.zh: 所以势头相当强劲，部分原因是新五年规划开局之年，年初往往较为积极。

subtitles.en: And I think after the got a strong one Q, there was a adjustment to that policy, to a less proactive one.
subtitles.zh: 我认为在一季度强劲之后，政策进行了调整，转向不那么积极。

subtitles.en: And probably the overshot in terms of the policy adjustments magnitude.
subtitles.zh: 而且政策调整的幅度可能过度了。

subtitles.en: I think there was likely intention to slow down some what, and there was probably overshoot.
subtitles.zh: 我认为本意是有所放缓，但可能超调了。

clips.speaker_context: Chief China Economist at UBS Securities
